_comment: Per-file, per-code ShellCheck exclusions for the `shellcheck` job (.github/scripts/shellcheck.sh, tests/shellcheck-gate.test.ts). Security loop round 3 added the gate over code that predates it; each entry below is a finding that existed on the day the gate landed, in a file owned by other work, excused only for that file and only for that code. Fix the finding and delete the entry; never add a code to silence a NEW finding without a reason a reviewer can check. Entries marked may_be_absent name files that exist on the regular branch but not on the branch that introduced the gate.

scripts/auto-enrich.sh.reason: Lines ~575-576: the idle-watchdog find/stat pipeline has a 2>/dev/null before -exec and again after it. Both only silence stderr, so behaviour is correct; tidy it when auto-enrich.sh is next edited under review.

scripts/backup-events-db.sh.reason: Line ~123: ls -t | grep picks the newest prior backup. Backup file names are generated by this script (events-YYYY-MM-DD.db.gz), so the non-alphanumeric-name hazard does not apply.

scripts/daily-automated.sh.reason: Pre-existing style findings (unused STATE_FILE and loop counter, local x=$(...) masking return codes in the report block, cd without || exit under set -e). Owned by the concurrent pipeline hardening work; to be fixed there.

scripts/phase3-weekly.sh.reason: Line ~119: exit $([ $ok = 1 ] && echo 0 || echo 1) in the smoke mode. The substitution yields a single digit, so word splitting cannot change it.

scripts/status.sh.reason: MISSING_PRICES is computed but not printed in this read-only status helper; harmless, remove when the helper is next touched.

docker/aa-run.sh.reason: Lines ~206 and ~219 loop over ls output (regular branch). The directories hold files this project names; replace with globs in a docker/ change.

docker/doctor.sh.reason: Line ~34 prints a literal ~ path in a diagnostic message (regular branch); the tilde is display text, not a path that is opened.
